0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game losing streak and 2-3 on the road) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, on a nine-game losing streak and 1-5 at home) in the Magic's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero, and Tristan da Silva, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic, Keyonte George, and Lauri Markkanen. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 120-117 win in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
